in_marathi.name: Koteswara
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Koteswara हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Koteswara is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Koti' meaning 'million' and 'Iswara' meaning 'god'. This name signifies the goddess who grants victory in all forms and aspects of life.
